note: Screened by Fo against Clarissa's filters. Leads wait for her Apply/Reject on the Job Hunt tab; decisions live in her browser. Sweeps 5:30am and 3pm PT daily.

leads.title: Sr. Supply & Demand Manager
leads.fit: Supply/demand balancing for the AV fleet, closest to her Sherwin-Williams supply-network work

details.summary: Owns Waymo's global supply and demand balance for autonomous vehicles and sensor suites: aligning commercial rollout targets, fleet maintenance and manufacturing/logistics capacity across markets. Hybrid Mountain View; reports to the Head of Vehicle Supply Planning & Materials Ops.

leads.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Fleet
leads.fit: Fleet program management; her 4,000-moves-a-year equipment-ops record fits the fleet lane

details.summary: Leads cross-functional fleet management programs across product, ops, systems engineering and design, owning end-to-end execution of Waymo's fleet roadmap where no playbook exists yet. Hybrid, Mountain View or San Francisco.

leads.title: Training Delivery Manager (Fleet Maintenance & Validation)
leads.fit: Training systems + fleet maintenance, two of her documented strengths in one seat

details.summary: Designs the train-the-trainer curriculum for fleet maintenance technicians and workshop management, building the program with Waymo's training team. Hybrid San Francisco or Tempe, AZ.

leads.title: Global Supply Manager
leads.fit: Vehicle/fleet supply sourcing and vendor management, her rate-negotiation sweet spot

details.summary: Indirect procurement at Lyft: sourcing strategy, supplier relationships and complex contract negotiation for safety, people and contingent-workforce spend, with heavy Excel cost modeling. San Francisco.

leads.title: Director of Supply Chain
leads.fit: Autonomous trucking supply chain, heavy-vehicle world she knows; director step up from her manager level

details.summary: Director-level supply chain build-out at Kodiak's autonomous trucking company, scaling Driver-as-a-Service freight ops with partners like Bosch and AWS. Mountain View. Director scope, above hands-on level.

leads.title: Senior Manager, Logistics Analytics & Optimization
leads.fit: Freight-network optimization and reporting, her Tableau/oracle-reporting lane at scale

details.summary: Leads a team of technical analysts optimizing Uber Freight's freight networks: advanced modeling, KPIs and automation across commercial strategy and operations. Hybrid San Francisco.

leads.title: Executive Assistant, Office of the Co-Founders
leads.fit: EA to two co-founders at a top AI startup; hourly role with overtime eligibility, so likely strong comp for hours worked

details.summary: Second EA to co-founders Bret Taylor (OpenAI board chair, ex-Salesforce co-CEO) and Clay Bavor (ex-Google Labs): complex travel, onsite meeting logistics, offsites and exec events on a high-trust founding team. In-person San Francisco.

leads.title: Executive Assistant, Legal & Partnerships
leads.fit: EA lane, contracts and partner-facing support; wide band, posted range clears the $90K floor comfortably

details.summary: EA to Sierra's General Counsel and Partnerships leaders: multi-leader calendar and travel management, meeting prep and follow-up, correspondence drafting, and team offsites. 5+ years EA experience; in-person San Francisco.

leads.title: Fleet Health Specialist
leads.fit: Fleet monitoring and maintenance ops for the robotaxi fleet; closest match to her fleet/dispatch background, watch for a technical background ask in the full posting

details.summary: Tracks fleet health and availability metrics, drives root-cause fixes with engineering and suppliers, and travels to regions for fleet inspections. Asking 3+ years in automotive service or fleet management with a related degree. San Francisco.

leads.title: Network Operations Manager
leads.fit: Manager-level ops role running a live network; your dispatch and driver-ops playbook transfers directly.

details.summary: Manages Waymo's IT network operations team under the WINS infrastructure group: major-incident ownership, ITIL governance and vendor-run deployments of firewalls, switches and UPS. Mountain View. IT infrastructure, not logistics.

leads.title: AV Compliance Lead, Fleet & Operator Compliance
leads.fit: Fleet + DOT/FMCSA compliance leadership, your exact regulatory strength in an AV fleet.

details.summary: Builds Waymo's vehicle and operator compliance program for global scaling: regulator relationships, permitting and registration, vendor management and executive KPI dashboards. Expects 12-15 years of program management and teams of 10+. Hybrid Mountain View.

leads.title: Head of Logistics
leads.fit: Senior logistics role over fleet moves; a stretch up from dispatch manager but your 4,000-moves-a-year record speaks to it.

details.summary: Stands up Waymo's entire logistics organization: global transport networks moving AVs and components, team building from scratch, cost reduction, reverse logistics and trade compliance. Expects 10+ years of logistics leadership. Mountain View.

leads.title: Procurement COE Manager
leads.fit: Clears your $90K floor with a posted range; procurement + vendor rate negotiation is on your resume.

details.summary: Runs Lyft's procurement center of excellence: supplier relationship programs, sourcing workflows rebuilt with AI and automation, and cross-functional cost work. 3-5+ years procurement with Oracle or Zip experience. San Francisco.

leads.title: Business Operations Manager, Office of the CEO
leads.fit: Already on the parked VC-sweep shortlist; exec-ops flavor in a freight company, review it here now.

details.summary: BizOps in the Office of the CEO: owns Flexport's biggest open questions end to end, builds the financial models, and runs the operating cadence for a freight mode or region. 4-6 years in banking, consulting or high-growth ops. San Francisco.

leads.title: Head of Data Center Logistics Practice
leads.fit: Also from the parked shortlist; senior logistics practice lead role.

details.summary: Owns the commercial motion for Flexport's data center logistics practice, moving AI compute racks ($1M+, 4,000 lb, lithium battery dangerous goods) with white-glove project management. A sales-leadership profile, not an ops one.

leads.title: Chief of Staff, Online Grocery
leads.fit: Remote chief-of-staff seat at a grocery/logistics company; your Safeway + delivery-ops background reads well here.

details.summary: Chief of staff to the GM of a ~200-person online grocery org: runs the operating rhythm, sharpens decision frameworks and handles communications. Individual contributor, no direct reports. US remote.

leads.title: Chief of Staff, Nuro Driver
leads.fit: CoS to AV company leadership; exec-ops lane, Mountain View commute.

details.summary: Chief of staff to the VP of the Nuro Driver autonomy platform: strategic program leadership, cross-org unblocking across engineering and safety, and partner execution. Mountain View.

leads.title: Executive Assistant, Growth Marketing
leads.fit: SF EA seat supporting marketing leadership; exec calendar and event support strengths.

details.summary: EA to the VP of Growth Marketing: heavy calendar and inbox management, travel, expense and PO approvals, and offsite planning with the CMO's EA. 7+ years EA experience; SF office 2 days a week.

leads.title: Executive Assistant, People
leads.fit: Second Figma EA opening; People-team support, SF onsite.

details.summary: EA to People-team VPs: calendars, tasks, expense and PO sign-off, and process optimization across the People org. 6+ years senior admin support; SF office 2 days a week.

leads.title: Chief of Staff to GM, Ads
leads.fit: CoS to a GM; heavier business-ops than pure EA, SF onsite.

details.summary: Chief of staff to the GM of Ads (product, engineering, data science): runs the executive operating agenda, planning cycles and cross-functional forums for one of Pinterest's most business-critical teams. San Francisco.
